sourceFile: "Diocesan Cycle of Prayer - Current.pdf", provided directly by Josh via Google Drive (file id 1sXskZRcg3i_z3IizjXmMDLAgwQxWeKTJ, folder "TEC Cycle of Prayer").
notes: The source's own list actually runs 1 through 37, not 1 through 31 -- a repeating sequential rotation with no calendar anchoring at all (not tied to day-of-month, day-of-week, or any date), which fit neither of this schema's two existing cycleTypes: 'dated' needs real calendar dates the source never gives, and 'monthly-recurring' is strictly 1-31 day-of-month. Raised directly with Josh rather than guessed at; his own resolution, 2026-09-29 ('Cut it off after 31'), was to drop items 32-37 (Honorary Canons of the Cathedral of Saint James; All Saints, Syracuse; Saint Andrew's, Valparaiso; Saint Anne's, Warsaw; and two Retired Clergy groups) so the remaining 31 items fit this app's existing day-of-month `monthly-recurring` shape cleanly, the same shape Arkansas already uses -- an editorial scoping decision, not a fabrication of structure the source never had. Items 32-37's content is disclosed here rather than silently dropped: Honorary Canons of the Cathedral of Saint James (John Beatty, Linda Buskirk, Paul Bradshaw, Katherine Clark, Michael Dwyer, Cynthia Guzzo, David Hyndman, Maxwell Johnson, Richard Kallenberg, Sharon Katona, Nancy Moody, Theodore Neidlinger, Hugh Page, Richard Phelps, Henry Randolph, David Rider, Gordon Samra, Kathryn Schneider, David Seger, SuzeAnne Silla, James Warnock, Teunisje Velthuizen); All Saints, Syracuse (Michael Fulk, Supply Priest); Saint Andrew's, Valparaiso (Cathy Carpenter, Rector); Saint Anne's, Warsaw (Amanda Henes, Interim Priest-in-Charge; in transition); two Retired Clergy name lists (Francis C. Gray, Edward S. Little II, John Blakslee, Susan Blubaugh, Paul Bradshaw, Marion Carpenter, Beverly Collinsworth, Joseph Czolgosz, George Douglass, Betty Frolick, Paul Greve, Margaret Harker, Thomas Hansen, John Houghton, David Hyndman; and Richard Kallenberg, Ross Mack, Theodore Neidlinger, Henry Randolph, Roberta Ring, Gordon Samra, John Schramm, David Seger, Kathy Thomas, Cindy VanParys, Teunisje Velthuizen).

The fetched Drive page also carried trailing content from a different diocese's own cycle (ending '...31 The Diocese of Honduras - Lloyd Allen Bishop...') immediately before this diocese's own 'A Cycle of Prayer for The Episcopal Diocese of Northern Indiana' header -- confirmed as page-adjacency noise from wherever this file sits in a combined PDF, not part of Northern Indiana's own list, and excluded entirely from this transcription.

A '+' marker appears after some names/roles with no legend given by the source (e.g. 'David Pearson Supply + Priest', day 6; 'David Evans Supply + Priest', day 19; 'Charlie Strietelmeier Supply +', day 25) -- preserved exactly as printed, likely denoting clergy/ordained status, same disclosed-not-decoded treatment this corpus already gives the identical '+' convention in episcopal-western-oregon-st-bede.json.

Day 26's 'In transition &. Kathy Townley Melendez Deacon' has a stray period after the ampersand, a plain extraction artifact -- rendered here as 'In transition & Kathy Townley Melendez, Deacon', not preserved as a typo, per this corpus's standing distinction between a source's own typo (preserved) and an extraction artifact (fixed).

Day 25 ('Calumet Episcopal Ministry Partnership') is recorded as a `category`, not a `parish`, since the source gives no place for the Partnership entity itself there -- distinct from days 5, 12, 14, 16, 17, and 28, where the Partnership is instead cited as the shared clergy arrangement for a specific NAMED parish (each of those stays a `parish` subject with the Partnership named in its own `note`).

Three subjects with multi-item source lists (Diocesan Missioners, day 7; Ministry with Children & Youth, day 13; Diocesan Leadership, day 18) have their full member/committee lists semicolon-joined into that subject's own `note`, for readability, with no name or role altered.
